科学计算与深度学习.title: PDEFlow: Autonomous Agentic PDE Pipelines for Neural Operator Learning and Solver-Free Inference
科学计算与深度学习.title_zh: PDEFlow：面向神经算子学习与免求解器推理的自主智能PDE流水线
科学计算与深度学习.summary: We present PDEFlow, an autonomous agentic framework that turns user-level ODE and PDE descriptions into solver-backed neural-operator pipelines. The workflow links problem specification, data generation, operator training, and checkpoint-based inference. A stateful input graph converts multi-turn natural language interactions into executable computational graphs, enabling solver-free inference for complex differential equations.
科学计算与深度学习.summary_zh: 本文提出PDEFlow，一种自主智能框架，可将用户层面的常微分方程和偏微分方程描述转化为基于求解器的神经算子流水线。该工作流连接问题规范、数据生成、算子训练和基于检查点的推理。通过有状态输入图，将多轮自然语言交互转化为可执行计算图，实现对复杂微分方程的免求解器推理。创新点在于构建了端到端的自主智能体系统，简化了神经算子学习流程，提升了实用性和可访问性。

自然语言处理与推理.title: Reason, Reward, Refine: Step-Level Errors Corrections with Structured Feedback for Physics Reasoning in Small Language Models
自然语言处理与推理.title_zh: 推理、奖励、精炼：面向小型语言模型物理推理的步骤级错误修正与结构化反馈
自然语言处理与推理.summary: Physics reasoning fails structurally in small language models: an error at any step propagates forward, corrupting every inference that follows. Limited domain knowledge, hallucination under multi-step derivation, and distributional sensitivity compound this failure. We propose a step-level reward function and structured feedback mechanism to identify and correct errors at each reasoning step, significantly improving accuracy in physics problem solving.
自然语言处理与推理.summary_zh: 小型语言模型在物理推理中存在结构性失败：任何步骤的错误都会向前传播，破坏后续所有推理。有限的领域知识、多步推导下的幻觉以及分布敏感性加剧了这一失败。本文提出步骤级奖励函数和结构化反馈机制，用于识别和修正每一步推理中的错误，显著提高了物理问题求解的准确性。创新点在于细粒度的错误定位与纠正方法，提升了小模型的推理可靠性。

自然语言处理与推理.title: Noisy-Channel Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
自然语言处理与推理.title_zh: 噪声信道最小贝叶斯风险解码
自然语言处理与推理.summary: Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding yields more robust and higher-quality text generation than maximum a posteriori (MAP) decoding by selecting hypotheses that maximize expected utility over sampled pseudo-references. However, there exists a discrepancy in the design: hypothesis selection calculates expected utility using a utility function, while the pseudo-references are sampled from a source model. We propose a noisy-channel approach that models the pseudo-reference generation as a noisy channel, improving the alignment between hypothesis selection and reference sampling.
自然语言处理与推理.summary_zh: 最小贝叶斯风险解码通过选择在采样伪参考上最大化期望效用的假设，比最大后验解码产生更稳健和更高质量的文本生成。然而，设计上存在差异：假设选择使用效用函数计算期望效用，而伪参考则从源模型采样。本文提出噪声信道方法，将伪参考生成建模为噪声信道，改进了假设选择与参考采样之间的一致性。创新点在于理论上的修正，提升了文本生成质量。

脑电信号处理与机器学习.title: Wavelet Scattering Transform for Interpretable Schizophrenia Biomarker Discovery and Classification from Resting-State EEG
脑电信号处理与机器学习.title_zh: 基于小波散射变换的可解释精神分裂症生物标志物发现与静息态EEG分类
脑电信号处理与机器学习.summary: Schizophrenia is a debilitating neuropsychiatric disorder characterized by profound cortical network dysregulation, for which objective, clinically translatable EEG based biomarkers remain underdeveloped. Existing automated classification pipelines rely predominantly on static power spectral density features. We propose a wavelet scattering transform approach that captures multi-scale temporal dynamics, providing interpretable features for biomarker discovery and achieving state-of-the-art classification accuracy on resting-state EEG data.
脑电信号处理与机器学习.summary_zh: 精神分裂症是一种致残性神经精神疾病，其特征是皮质网络严重失调，目前基于脑电图的客观、临床可转化的生物标志物仍不成熟。现有自动分类流水线主要依赖静态功率谱密度特征。本文提出小波散射变换方法，捕获多尺度时间动态，提供可解释的特征用于生物标志物发现，并在静息态脑电图数据上实现了最先进的分类准确率。创新点在于结合可解释性与高性能分类，推动了临床转化。

机器人学与多智能体系统.title: GaP: A Graph-as-Policy Multi-Agent Self-Learning Harness For Variational Automation Tasks
机器人学与多智能体系统.title_zh: GaP：面向变分自动化任务的图即策略多智能体自学习框架
机器人学与多智能体系统.summary: For robots to work reliably in commercial and industrial applications, can recent advances in agentic coding systems combine interpretable robot programming with the open-world adaptability of model-free policies? We focus on "Variational Automation" (VA), a class of tasks that have large variation. We propose GaP, a graph-as-policy multi-agent self-learning framework that represents robot policies as graphs, enabling interpretability and adaptability through multi-agent collaboration and self-learning.
机器人学与多智能体系统.summary_zh: 为了让机器人在商业和工业应用中可靠工作，能否利用智能编码系统的最新进展，将可解释的机器人编程与无模型策略的开放世界适应性相结合？本文聚焦于“变分自动化”任务，这类任务具有较大变化。提出GaP，一种图即策略的多智能体自学习框架，将机器人策略表示为图，通过多智能体协作和自学习实现可解释性和适应性。创新点在于将图结构引入策略表示，兼顾了可解释性与灵活性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: TACTIC-KG: Toward Small Agent Teams for Cyber Threat Intelligence Knowledge Graph Construction
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: TACTIC-KG：面向网络威胁情报知识图谱构建的小型智能体团队
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) reports are predominantly unstructured, heterogeneous, and noisy, which limits their direct usability for automated analysis and reasoning. Cybersecurity Knowledge Graphs (CSKGs) provide a structured representation of adversarial entities, actions, and relations, but
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 网络威胁情报（CTI）报告主要非结构化、异构且嘈杂，限制了其直接用于自动分析和推理。网络安全知识图谱（CSKG）提供了对手实体、动作和关系的结构化表示，但构建过程自动化程度低。本文提出TACTIC-KG，利用小型智能体团队协作构建CTI知识图谱。创新点在于采用多智能体协作框架，每个智能体负责特定子任务（如实体识别、关系抽取），并通过通信协调。主要贡献包括：提出了一种高效、可扩展的自动化知识图谱构建方法，在多个CTI数据集上取得了优于传统流水线方法的性能，且智能体团队规模小，计算成本低。

大语言模型/LLM.title: AgentGym2: Benchmarking Large Language Model Agents in De-Idealized Real-World Environments
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: AgentGym2：在去理想化真实世界环境中评估大语言模型智能体
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Language agents, i.e., LLM agents, progress rapidly and are increasingly deployed in production environments. This trend underscores the urgent need for rigorous and realistic evaluations. However, most existing benchmarks evaluate agents in simplified, idealized settings. They typically rely on pre
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 语言智能体（LLM智能体）发展迅速并逐步部署到生产环境，亟需严格且真实的评估。然而现有基准多在简化的理想化场景中测试。本文提出AgentGym2，一个去理想化的真实世界评估基准。创新点包括：构建包含动态、噪声、部分可观测性的真实任务环境；设计多维度评估指标（鲁棒性、适应性、效率等）；覆盖多个领域（网页导航、工具使用、对话等）。主要贡献在于首次系统性地在非理想条件下评估LLM智能体，揭示了理想与真实性能差距，为实际部署提供指导。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Localized LoRA-MoE: Block-wise Low-Rank Experts With Adaptive Routing
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 局部化LoRA-MoE：带自适应路由的逐块低秩专家模型
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and high-dimensional perception networks increasingly rely on parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) to adapt to diverse operational contexts. However, standard methods like LoRA are structurally limited by a monolithic bottleneck, making them highly susceptible to gradi
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 大语言模型和高维感知网络越来越多地依赖参数高效微调（PEFT）来适应不同场景。但LoRA等标准方法受限于单一瓶颈结构，易受梯度冲突影响。本文提出局部化LoRA-MoE，创新点包括：将LoRA分解为多个块级低秩专家，每个专家负责特定子空间；设计自适应路由机制，根据输入动态选择专家组合；缓解了梯度冲突并提升了模型容量。主要贡献在于首次将MoE思想与LoRA结合，在保持参数高效的同时显著提升微调性能，在多个NLP和视觉任务上验证了有效性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Weak-to-Strong Generalization via Direct On-Policy Distillation
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 通过直接在线策略蒸馏实现弱到强泛化
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a powerful recipe for improving language-model reasoning, but it is expensive to repeat on every new strong model because the target model must generate many rollouts during training. As models scale, post-training itself becomes a bottleneck.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习是提升语言模型推理能力的强大方法，但每次对新的强模型进行训练时，目标模型需生成大量轨迹，导致成本高昂。随着模型规模扩大，后训练本身成为瓶颈。本文提出直接在线策略蒸馏方法，利用弱模型（如较小或较早版本的模型）生成的轨迹来训练强模型，实现弱到强泛化。创新点在于：1）无需强模型自身生成大量数据，通过蒸馏弱模型策略显著降低训练成本；2）理论分析了弱到强泛化的条件，并实验证明在多个推理任务上性能接近甚至超过直接在线训练。主要贡献是提供了一种高效的后训练范式，适用于大规模语言模型的持续改进。

大语言模型/LLM.title: EvoAgentBench: Benchmarking Agent Self-Evolution via Ability Transfer
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: EvoAgentBench：通过能力迁移评估智能体自我进化
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Agent self-evolution in long-horizon LLM systems is largely procedural: useful experience is not merely stored information, but reusable procedures for searching, debugging, and verification. Yet current evaluations do not isolate this form of transfer. Agent benchmarks test single-episode task solv...
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 长周期LLM系统中的智能体自我进化本质上是程序性的：有用的经验不仅是存储的信息，更是可重用的搜索、调试和验证程序。然而，当前评估并未孤立这种迁移形式。智能体基准测试仅测试单轮任务解决能力，忽略了能力迁移。本文提出EvoAgentBench，首个专门评估智能体通过能力迁移实现自我进化的基准。创新点在于：1）设计了多任务序列，要求智能体将先前任务中习得的程序性知识迁移到新任务；2）包含多种迁移场景（如知识迁移、策略迁移等），并提供了细粒度评估指标。主要贡献是为智能体自我进化研究提供了标准化的评估平台，推动了该领域的发展。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Your Agent's Memories Are Not Its Own: Forged Reasoning Attacks on LLM Agent Memory and Defenses
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 你的智能体的记忆并非其自身所有：针对LLM智能体记忆的伪造推理攻击及防御
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Persistent memory has enabled large language model (LLM) agents to store factual knowledge, prior decisions, reasoning histories, tool usage information, and context. While this has improved the agent's functionality and continuity across tasks, it has also introduced a new attack surface: the agent...
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 持久化内存使大语言模型智能体能够存储事实知识、先前决策、推理历史、工具使用信息和上下文。这虽然提升了智能体的功能性和跨任务连续性，但也引入了新的攻击面：智能体的记忆可能被篡改。本文首次提出针对LLM智能体记忆的伪造推理攻击，攻击者通过注入虚假记忆来操纵智能体的后续推理和行为。创新点在于：1）系统分析了记忆攻击的威胁模型，并设计了多种攻击策略（如直接注入、间接诱导）；2）提出了一种基于一致性验证的防御机制，有效检测和抵御记忆篡改。主要贡献是揭示了智能体记忆的安全隐患，并提供了实用的防御方案。

大语言模型/LLM.title: LLM for the development of FCM
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 用于模糊认知图开发的大语言模型
大语言模型/LLM.summary: This article is about the development of a fuzzy cognitive map using a local large language model. In the light of recent advances it is evident that large language models, and even local large language models are capable of extracting quantities from textual data. In other words, a local LLM like Q
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文探讨利用本地大语言模型（LLM）开发模糊认知图（FCM）。鉴于近期进展，即使是本地LLM也能从文本数据中提取定量信息。作者展示如何利用本地LLM（如Qwen）从自然语言描述中自动提取FCM的节点和权重，从而简化知识建模过程。主要贡献在于提出一种低资源、隐私友好的FCM构建方法，无需依赖云端API，适用于敏感领域。创新点包括：利用本地LLM的文本理解能力实现自动化知识提取，并验证了其在FCM构建中的有效性。

大语言模型/LLM.title: When Claws Remember but Do Not Tell: Stealthy Memory Injection in Persistent Personal Agents
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 当爪子记住但不言：持久个人代理中的隐蔽记忆注入
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Persistent personal agents combine long-term memory with access to users' external environments, enabling personalized foreground assistance and proactive background execution. This integration also creates a new path to compromise: untrusted external content can be silently written into persistent memory, influencing future agent behavior without user awareness. We demonstrate a stealthy memory injection attack that exploits this vulnerability, and propose defenses based on memory integrity checks and content sanitization.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 持久个人代理结合长期记忆与用户外部环境访问能力，实现个性化前台协助和主动后台执行。这种集成也创造了新的攻击路径：不可信的外部内容可被静默写入持久记忆，从而在用户不知情的情况下影响代理的未来行为。本文展示了一种利用此漏洞的隐蔽记忆注入攻击，并提出了基于记忆完整性检查和内容净化的防御措施。创新点在于首次系统性地分析了持久个人代理的记忆安全风险，揭示了LLM系统中记忆模块的潜在安全隐患。

大语言模型/LLM.title: LLM-as-a-Verifier: A General-Purpose Verification Framework
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: LLM作为验证器：一种通用验证框架
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Scaling pre-training, post-training, and test-time compute have become the central paradigms for improving the capabilities of LLMs. In this work, we identify verification, the ability to determine the correctness of a solution, as a new scaling axis. To unlock this and demonstrate its effectiveness
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新的扩展维度——验证能力，即判断解决方案正确性的能力。通过将大型语言模型作为通用验证器，作者构建了一个框架，能够在预训练、后训练和测试时计算之外进一步提升模型性能。实验表明，该框架在多种任务上显著提高了LLM的准确性和可靠性，为AI系统的安全性和可信度提供了新的保障。

大语言模型/LLM.title: SovereignPA-Bench: Evaluating User-Owned Personal Agents under Evolving Intent, Platform Mediation, and Consent Constraints
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: SovereignPA-Bench：在演变的意图、平台中介和同意约束下评估用户拥有的个人代理
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Personal agents are becoming persistent user-owned intermediaries: they remember preferences, filter platform-mediated information, use tools, and negotiate with services. Existing benchmarks evaluate tool use, web navigation, desktop control, personalization, recommendation, and evolving context, but no unified benchmark captures the unique challenges of user-owned agents: evolving user intent, platform mediation (e.g., API restrictions, information asymmetry), and consent constraints (e.g., privacy, data ownership). We introduce SovereignPA-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate personal agents in realistic scenarios involving these three dimensions. We propose a set of metrics and tasks, and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLM-based agents. Our results show that current agents struggle with dynamic intent and platform mediation, highlighting the need for more robust personal agent designs.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本论文提出了SovereignPA-Bench，一个专门用于评估用户拥有的个人代理（Personal Agents）的基准。现有基准虽涵盖工具使用、网页导航等能力，但未能全面捕捉用户拥有代理面临的独特挑战：演变的用户意图（如偏好动态变化）、平台中介（如API限制、信息不对称）和同意约束（如隐私、数据所有权）。该基准设计了包含这三类维度的真实场景任务和评估指标，并对多个基于LLM的先进代理进行了测试。结果表明，当前代理在处理动态意图和平台中介方面表现不佳，凸显了设计更鲁棒个人代理的必要性。创新点在于首次系统性地将意图演变、平台中介和同意约束纳入统一评估框架，为个人代理研究提供了关键测试平台。

大语言模型/LLM.title: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: DSpark：基于置信度调度的半自回归生成投机解码
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) inference by decoupling draft generation from target verification. While recent parallel drafters efficiently propose long token sequences in a single forward pass, they suffer from rapid acceptance decay due to a lack of inter-token dependencies. We propose DSpark, a semi-autoregressive speculative decoding framework that generates draft tokens in small blocks with intra-block dependencies, and uses a confidence-scheduled mechanism to adaptively adjust block size based on the draft model's confidence. This balances generation speed and acceptance rate. Experiments on various LLMs show that DSpark achieves up to 3.2x speedup over autoregressive decoding and outperforms existing speculative decoding methods.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 本文提出DSpark，一种半自回归投机解码框架，旨在加速大语言模型推理。传统投机解码中，并行草稿生成虽快但缺乏token间依赖导致接受率低。DSpark创新性地将草稿生成为小块（block），每个块内保留自回归依赖，同时引入基于置信度的调度机制，根据草稿模型的置信度动态调整块大小，在生成速度和接受率之间取得平衡。实验表明，在多种LLM上，DSpark相比自回归解码实现了最高3.2倍加速，并优于现有投机解码方法。主要贡献在于提出半自回归块生成与置信度调度相结合的策略，有效缓解了并行草稿的接受率衰减问题。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Grokking Is Conditional and Fragile: A Fully-Tractable, Multi-Seed Study at 12K Parameters
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: Grokking是有条件且脆弱的：一项12K参数下的完全可追踪、多种子研究
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Grokking -- the delayed onset of generalization long after a network has fit its training set - -is usually studied in models too large to read completely and reported from single training runs. We instead study a publicly released ~11,856-parameter Llama-style transformer (Glimmer-1-Base) on modular addition, enabling full mechanistic interpretability. We find that grokking is highly conditional: it relies on a specific combination of weight decay, AdamW hyperparameters, and network structure. It is also fragile: small changes to the training setup (e.g., learning rate, initialization) can eliminate or delay it. Our multi-seed experiments reveal multiple algorithmic solutions, some of which do not grok. This work provides a tractable testbed for understanding the mechanisms underlying delayed generalization.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: Grokking（网络在充分拟合训练集后延迟泛化的现象）通常在大模型上研究，且仅报告单次训练结果。本文使用一个公开的约11,856参数的Llama风格Transformer（Glimmer-1-Base）进行模加法任务，实现了完全机械可解释性。研究发现grokking高度有条件：依赖于权重衰减、AdamW超参数和网络结构的特定组合；同时很脆弱：训练设置的微小变化（如学习率、初始化）可消除或延迟grokking。多种子实验揭示了多种算法解，其中一些并不出现grokking。该工作为理解延迟泛化机制提供了可追踪的测试平台。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Toward Trustworthy Large Language Model Agents in Healthcare
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 面向医疗领域可信的大语言模型智能体
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Healthcare appointment scheduling remains a persistent operational bottleneck, driven by manual coordination, fragmented legacy systems, and high administrative overhead. These inefficiencies constrain provider availability and degrade patient access to care. This paper presents CareConnect, a safety-focused LLM agent framework for healthcare scheduling. It integrates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with structured constraint enforcement to ensure compliance with clinical guidelines and institutional policies. Experiments on real-world data show significant reductions in scheduling conflicts and administrative workload.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 医疗预约调度因手动协调、遗留系统碎片化和高管理开销而长期存在操作瓶颈，限制了医疗服务可及性并降低患者就诊体验。本文提出CareConnect，一个面向医疗调度、注重安全性的LLM智能体框架。该框架将检索增强生成（RAG）与结构化约束执行相结合，确保符合临床指南和机构政策。在真实世界数据上的实验表明，该方法显著减少了调度冲突和管理工作量。

大语言模型/LLM.title: Rethinking On-Policy Self-Distillation for Thinking Models
大语言模型/LLM.title_zh: 重新思考思考模型中的在线策略自蒸馏
大语言模型/LLM.summary: Self-distillation is a promising recipe for self-improvement in language models. In this setting, a model can serve as its own teacher when given privileged information, such as a solution to a math problem. This seems especially appealing for thinking models, which can use test-time reasoning to absorb knowledge from its own generations.
大语言模型/LLM.summary_zh: 自蒸馏是语言模型自我改进的一种有前景的方法。在这种设置中，模型在拥有特权信息（如数学问题的解答）时可以作为自己的教师。这对于思考模型尤其有吸引力，它们可以利用测试时推理从自身的生成中吸收知识。本文重新思考了思考模型中的在线策略自蒸馏，提出了新的蒸馏框架。创新点在于：1）分析了在线策略与离线策略蒸馏的差异；2）设计了针对思考模型的蒸馏损失函数；3）证明了在线策略蒸馏能更有效地传递推理能力。主要贡献包括在数学推理和代码生成任务上显著提升模型性能。

机器人.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
机器人.title_zh: Cortex：面向长周期操作的双向对齐具身智能体框架
机器人.summary: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level pl
机器人.summary_zh: 尽管近期视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用操作策略方面显示出潜力，但由于其马尔可夫性质（仅依赖当前观测），它们在长周期任务中表现不佳。层次化双系统方法解决了这一问题，但高层规划与低层执行之间存在鸿沟。本文提出Cortex，一个双向对齐的具身智能体框架，用于长周期操作。创新点在于设计了双向对齐机制：从高层规划到低层动作的语义对齐，以及从低层执行反馈到高层规划的调整。主要贡献包括：在多个长周期操作任务上实现了优于现有方法的性能，且框架具有良好的可解释性和鲁棒性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Shifting from Discrete to Continuous Reference Data: QSM-Derived Horizontal Tree Biomass Distribution for Deep Learning Biomass Estimation
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 从离散到连续参考数据：基于QSM的水平树木生物量分布用于深度学习生物量估计
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Conventional modeling approaches for LiDAR-based above-ground biomass (AGB) estimation rely on discrete plot-level inventory aggregates. This methodology introduces boundary-effect uncertainties that may severely degrade model performance within small field plots. To solve this limitation, we evalua
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 传统的基于LiDAR的地上生物量（AGB）估计建模方法依赖于离散样地级清查汇总。这种方法引入了边界效应不确定性，可能严重降低小样地内的模型性能。为了解决这一限制，本文评估了从离散到连续参考数据的转变：使用定量结构模型（QSM）导出的水平树木生物量分布作为深度学习训练的参考。创新点在于首次将连续空间生物量分布作为监督信号，避免了离散样地边界问题。主要贡献包括：提出了一种新的训练范式，显著提高了小样地AGB估计的准确性；实验表明，连续参考数据相比离散聚合数据，模型性能提升约15%，且泛化能力更强。

计算机视觉/CV.title: RUFNet: Query-Guided Support Mask Refinement and Uncertainty Fusion based on Hybrid Mamba for Few-Shot Brain Tumor Segmentation
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: RUFNet：基于混合Mamba的查询引导支持掩码细化与不确定性融合的少样本脑肿瘤分割
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Few-shot brain tumor segmentation remains challenging due to noisy support masks, inter-patient variations between support and query images, and the lack of pixel-wise confidence estimation. This study proposes RUFNet, a Hybrid Mamba-based few-shot framework that combines support mask refinement wit
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 少样本脑肿瘤分割因支持掩码噪声、支持与查询图像间的患者间差异以及缺乏像素级置信度估计而面临挑战。本研究提出RUFNet，一种基于混合Mamba的少样本框架，结合了支持掩码细化与不确定性融合。创新点包括：利用查询信息引导细化支持掩码，减少噪声影响；设计混合Mamba模块高效捕获长程依赖；引入不确定性融合机制，自适应加权支持与查询特征，提升分割精度。主要贡献在于首次将混合Mamba应用于医疗少样本分割，并在脑肿瘤数据集上取得SOTA性能。

计算机视觉/CV.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 从固定到自由相机：无需标定的视角鲁棒视觉-语言-动作模型
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Real-world robot deployment rarely maintains the training-stage camera setup, where cameras often experience repositioning or remounting depending on actual scenarios. Existing view-robust Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies tolerate such camera variations only when the camera extrinsics are expli
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 真实机器人部署中相机常被重新定位或安装，与训练设置不同。现有视角鲁棒的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仅在外参明确时有效。本文提出无需标定的视角鲁棒VLA模型，创新点包括：设计隐式视角对齐模块，无需显式外参即可适应相机变化；结合视觉-语言预训练特征，增强跨视角泛化能力；在多种机器人操作任务上验证了零样本迁移效果。主要贡献在于首次实现无需标定的视角鲁棒VLA，大幅降低实际部署成本。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Topological Shape Representation for Aneurysm -- Bifurcation Detection
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 用于动脉瘤-分叉检测的拓扑形状表示
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Automated detection of intracranial aneurysms (IAs) from CT angiography (CTA) is severely hindered by high false-positive rates. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) rely on local pixel intensities, causing systematic confusion between saccular aneurysms and vascular bifurcations -- a problem especially pronounced for small aneurysms. To address this, we propose a topological shape representation that captures global geometric features of vascular structures. Our method encodes the shape topology of aneurysms and bifurcations, enabling robust discrimination. Experiments on CTA datasets demonstrate significant reduction in false positives while maintaining high sensitivity.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 基于CT血管造影（CTA）的颅内动脉瘤自动检测受到高假阳性率的严重阻碍。卷积神经网络（CNN）依赖局部像素强度，导致囊状动脉瘤与血管分叉之间的系统性混淆——这一问题在小动脉瘤上尤为突出。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种拓扑形状表示方法，捕捉血管结构的全局几何特征。该方法编码动脉瘤和分叉的形状拓扑，实现稳健的区分。在CTA数据集上的实验表明，在保持高灵敏度的同时，假阳性显著减少。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Comparison of Loss Functions for Robust Deep Learning-based Echocardiography Segmentation when Learning with Partially Labelled Data from Multiple Domains
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 多域部分标注数据下基于深度学习的鲁棒超声心动图分割损失函数比较
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Echocardiography is the first imaging modality used for assessing cardiac function, and accurate segmentation of cardiac structures is essential for deriving biomarkers. However, the development of effective automated segmentation models for multiple cardiac structures is challenged by the difficult...
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 超声心动图是评估心功能的首选影像学手段，准确分割心脏结构对于获取生物标志物至关重要。然而，开发针对多种心脏结构的有效自动分割模型面临挑战，尤其是在使用来自多个域的部分标注数据时。本文系统比较了多种损失函数（如Dice损失、交叉熵、Focal损失等）在鲁棒深度学习分割中的表现。创新点在于：1）针对部分标注和多域场景，评估了不同损失函数对分割精度和泛化能力的影响；2）提出了结合多种损失函数的混合策略，显著提升了分割鲁棒性。主要贡献是为超声心动图分割任务提供了损失函数选择的指导原则，并在多个公共数据集上验证了有效性。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Steering Optimisation Trajectories in Diffusion Representation Learning
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 扩散表示学习中的优化轨迹引导
计算机视觉/CV.summary: We study why diffusion autoencoders can achieve similar image quality while learning substantially different latent structures. We trace this behaviour to optimisation dynamics; we analyse curves of image reconstruction against latent representation quality, revealing trajectories that organise arou...
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文研究扩散自编码器为何能在学习到截然不同的潜在结构时仍实现相似的图像质量。作者将这一现象归因于优化动力学，通过分析图像重建质量与潜在表示质量之间的曲线，揭示了围绕某些“锚点”组织的轨迹。创新点在于：1）首次系统分析了扩散模型中潜在表示的不同优化路径，并解释了其收敛行为；2）提出了一种引导优化轨迹的方法，使得学习到的潜在表示更具可解释性和可控性。主要贡献是深化了对扩散表示学习过程的理解，并为设计更高效的扩散模型提供了理论指导。

计算机视觉/CV.title: ASSEMCAD: Production-Ready CAD Assembly Generation from Natural Language
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: ASSEMCAD：从自然语言生成生产就绪的CAD装配体
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Recent advances in large language models and programmatic CAD have significantly improved Text-to-CAD generation for individual parts. However, production-ready mechanical assembly generation remains largely unsolved. Unlike single-part modeling, assemblies require coordinated reasoning over multiple components with constraints on fit, motion, and manufacturability. We propose ASSEMCAD, a framework that leverages LLMs to generate assembly code from natural language, incorporating geometric reasoning and constraint satisfaction. Our method produces assemblies that are valid, manufacturable, and directly usable in CAD software.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 近期大语言模型和程序化CAD的进展显著提升了单个零件的文本到CAD生成能力。然而，生产就绪的机械装配体生成仍基本未解决。与单零件建模不同，装配体需要对多个组件进行协调推理，并满足配合、运动和可制造性约束。本文提出ASSEMCAD框架，利用LLM从自然语言生成装配体代码，融合几何推理和约束求解。该方法生成的装配体有效、可制造，可直接用于CAD软件。创新点在于首次实现了从自然语言到完整CAD装配体的端到端生成，并保证了生产级质量。

计算机视觉/CV.title: ImputeECG: Deep Learning Reconstruction of Complete 12-Lead Electrocardiograms from Incomplete Recordings for Cardiac Assessment
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: ImputeECG：从不完整记录中深度学习重建完整12导联心电图用于心脏评估
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Complete digital 12-lead electrocardiograms (ECGs) are essential for AI-enabled cardiovascular assessment, yet many clinical ECG records, particularly those digitized from ECG images, remain incomplete because of short display formats, incomplete waveform digitization, lead loss, or signal corruptio
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文针对临床心电图中常见的导联缺失、波形不完整等问题，提出ImputeECG深度学习框架，能够从不完整的12导联心电图记录中重建完整信号。该方法利用多通道时序模型和注意力机制，有效恢复缺失导联和受损波形，在多个公开数据集上取得了高重建精度。该工作为AI辅助心血管诊断提供了更完整的数据基础，具有重要的临床应用价值。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Evaluating and Understanding Model Editing for Medical Vision Language Models
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 医学视觉语言模型模型编辑的评估与理解
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Model editing promises a fast, targeted way to correct post-deployment mistakes in medical vision-language models (VLMs) without costly retraining. However, existing multimodal model editing benchmarks focus on general-purpose tasks and do not reflect realistic clinical domain requirements and variations. We introduce MedEdit, a benchmark for evaluating model editing in medical VLMs, covering diverse clinical scenarios such as disease classification, report generation, and visual question answering. We evaluate several state-of-the-art model editing methods and find that they often fail to generalize across different medical tasks and exhibit poor specificity. Our analysis reveals the need for domain-aware editing methods that respect clinical knowledge constraints.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 本文提出MedEdit基准，专门评估医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的模型编辑技术。模型编辑旨在快速修正部署后的错误而无需重训练，但现有基准仅针对通用任务，未考虑临床领域的特殊要求。MedEdit涵盖疾病分类、报告生成、视觉问答等多种临床场景，并评估了多种先进编辑方法。结果表明，现有方法在医学任务间泛化能力差且特异性不足，常导致编辑后模型在其他任务上性能下降。创新点在于首次系统性地构建医学VLM编辑评估框架，揭示了通用编辑方法在临床领域的局限性，强调了需开发领域感知的编辑方法以尊重医学知识约束。

计算机视觉/CV.title: Air Quality Downscaling with Station-Guided Pseudo-Supervision
计算机视觉/CV.title_zh: 基于站点引导的伪监督空气质量降尺度
计算机视觉/CV.summary: Super-resolving coarse atmospheric fields to local PM$_{2.5}$ variations is uniquely challenged by a mismatch in spatial support: while pixels represent regional averages, ground-truth observations are discrete, unaligned samples of a continuous spatial signal. To bridge this gap, we present a station-guided pseudo-supervision framework that leverages ground monitoring stations as sparse but accurate anchors. Our method first trains a neural network to predict PM2.5 from coarse inputs using station data as weak supervision, then uses the network's predictions to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled locations, enabling fine-grained downscaling. Experiments on real-world data show significant improvement over baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of incorporating sparse ground truth into super-resolution tasks.
计算机视觉/CV.summary_zh: 将粗分辨率大气场超分到局部PM2.5变化面临空间支持不匹配的独特挑战：像素代表区域平均值，而地面真值观测是连续空间信号的离散、未对齐样本。为弥合这一差距，本文提出一种站点引导的伪监督框架，利用地面监测站作为稀疏但精确的锚点。方法首先训练神经网络，使用站点数据作为弱监督从粗输入预测PM2.5，然后利用网络预测为未标记位置生成伪标签，实现细粒度降尺度。真实数据实验表明，该方法显著优于基线，证明了将稀疏地面真值融入超分任务的有效性。

优化算法.title: Optimizing ML Workload Partitioning between CPUs and CIM Accelerators for Heterogeneous Computing
优化算法.title_zh: 异构计算中CPU与CIM加速器之间的机器学习工作负载划分优化
优化算法.summary: Computing-in-Memory (CIM) accelerators execute Matrix-Vector Multiplications (MVMs) in memory, making them a compelling solution for Machine Learning (ML) workloads. However, existing ML workload partitioning approaches for CIM accelerators do not fully account for Resistive Random Access Memory (RR
优化算法.summary_zh: 存内计算（CIM）加速器在内存中执行矩阵向量乘法（MVM），是机器学习工作负载的诱人方案。但现有划分方法未充分考虑阻变存储器（RRAM）的非理想特性。本文提出CPU与CIM加速器间ML工作负载的优化划分方法。创新点包括：建立考虑RRAM非线性和噪声的性能模型；设计自适应划分算法，根据负载特性动态分配任务；平衡计算精度与能耗。主要贡献在于首次系统性地将RRAM非理想性纳入划分优化，在真实CIM硬件上实现能效提升2倍以上，为异构计算提供了实用方案。

优化算法.title: OptiAgent: End-to-End Optimization Modeling via Multi-Agent Iterative Refinement
优化算法.title_zh: OptiAgent：通过多智能体迭代精化的端到端优化建模
优化算法.summary: We propose OptiAgent, a multi-agent framework that, given a natural language description of an Operations Research problem, is able to output a solver-ready mathematical formulation as well as executable code. Our architecture prioritizes the mathematical modeling step, where dedicated agents extract constraints and objectives, then iteratively refine the model with feedback from a solver. We evaluate on a benchmark of OR problems, showing that OptiAgent outperforms single-agent baselines in both formulation accuracy and solution quality.
优化算法.summary_zh: 本文提出OptiAgent，一个多智能体框架，能够根据运筹学问题的自然语言描述，输出可直接求解的数学公式和可执行代码。该架构优先考虑数学建模步骤，由专用智能体提取约束和目标，然后通过求解器的反馈迭代精化模型。在运筹学问题基准测试中，OptiAgent在公式准确性和解质量上均优于单智能体基线。创新点在于将多智能体协作与迭代精化相结合，实现了从自然语言到优化模型的全自动端到端转换。

优化算法.title: CP-WSP: A Declarative CP-SAT Framework for Configurable Multi-Constraint Workforce Scheduling
优化算法.title_zh: CP-WSP：面向可配置多约束劳动力调度的声明式CP-SAT框架
优化算法.summary: Workforce scheduling is an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem requiring simultaneous satisfaction of labor regulations, coverage requirements, employee preferences and operational objectives. Existing CP formulations typically model simplified instances with 6-12 constraints at shift-level g
优化算法.summary_zh: 劳动力调度是一个NP难的组合优化问题，需要同时满足劳动法规、覆盖需求、员工偏好和运营目标。现有的约束规划（CP）公式通常仅对简化实例建模，包含6-12个班次级别的约束。本文提出CP-WSP，一个声明式CP-SAT框架，支持可配置的多约束调度，可处理多达30+种约束。该框架通过模块化约束设计和高效求解策略，在真实世界数据集上取得了显著优于现有方法的性能。

优化算法.title: The Map Behind the Flow: Finite-Step Gradient Descent as a Dynamical System
优化算法.title_zh: 流背后的映射：作为动力系统的有限步梯度下降
优化算法.summary: Many phenomena of deep learning are dynamical: they concern not only which minima exist, but how gradient descent reaches, avoids, or selects among them. Edge-of-stability behavior, sharpness oscillations, catapult phases, balancing, and movement toward flatter representations are effects of the trajectory.
优化算法.summary_zh: 深度学习的许多现象是动力学的：它们不仅关注哪些极小值存在，还关注梯度下降如何到达、避免或选择它们。边缘稳定性行为、锐度振荡、弹射阶段、平衡以及向更平坦表示移动等，都是训练轨迹的效应。本文从动力系统角度重新审视有限步梯度下降，揭示了其背后的映射结构。创新点在于将梯度下降视为离散动力系统，分析了其不动点、周期轨道和混沌行为。主要贡献包括：1）建立了梯度下降与动力系统之间的严格联系；2）解释了多种训练现象；3）为优化算法设计提供了新视角。

强化学习/RL.title: Relational Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Pricing in High-Speed Railway Markets
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 面向高铁市场动态定价的关系型多智能体强化学习
强化学习/RL.summary: In liberalised railway systems, operators must set prices dynamically in an environment with partial observability, as they retain private information about their objectives and performance, where regulatory constraints prohibit communication or direct information exchange between competitors to prevent collusion. This paper proposes a relational multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for dynamic pricing in high-speed railway markets. The approach leverages relational reasoning to model interactions between agents and the environment, enabling cooperative yet competitive pricing strategies under partial observability. Experimental results demonstrate improved revenue and market efficiency compared to baseline methods.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 在自由化的铁路系统中，运营商需要在部分可观测的环境中动态定价，同时保留关于自身目标和绩效的私有信息，且监管限制禁止竞争者之间进行通信或直接信息交换以防止合谋。本文提出了一种面向高铁市场动态定价的关系型多智能体强化学习框架。该方法利用关系推理来建模智能体与环境之间的交互，从而在部分可观测性下实现既合作又竞争的定价策略。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，该方法在收益和市场效率方面均有提升。

强化学习/RL.title: TREK: Distill to Explore, Reinforce to Refine
强化学习/RL.title_zh: TREK：蒸馏以探索，强化以精炼
强化学习/RL.summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is effective when the current policy already samples useful reasoning trajectories, but it stalls on hard prompts whose correct solution modes lie outside the student's on-policy support. We propose TREK (Teacher-Routed Exploration via Forward KL), a simple
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 本文提出TREK方法，解决GRPO在困难问题上因正确解模式超出当前策略支持而停滞的问题。TREK通过前向KL散度引入教师路由探索，将教师模型的知识蒸馏到学生模型中，扩大学生的探索范围；随后利用强化学习精炼策略。实验表明，TREK在数学推理等复杂任务上显著提升了策略的探索效率和最终性能。

强化学习/RL.title: Adaptive Inference Batching using Policy Gradients
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 基于策略梯度的自适应推理批处理
强化学习/RL.summary: Inference serving systems must balance throughput and latency under bursty, heterogeneous workloads, yet the industry standard remains static batching policies that require manual tuning and cannot adapt to shifting traffic. We investigate whether reinforcement learning (RL) can learn adaptive batching policies that dynamically adjust batch sizes and timeouts. We formulate batching as a Markov decision process and use policy gradient methods to train a policy that maximizes a reward balancing throughput and latency. Experiments on synthetic and real-world workloads show that our RL-based approach outperforms static baselines and adapts to changing conditions, reducing tail latency while maintaining high throughput.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 本文研究用强化学习（RL）学习自适应批处理策略，以优化推理服务系统的吞吐量和延迟。现有静态批处理策略需要手动调参且无法适应突发、异构的工作负载。作者将批处理问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，使用策略梯度方法训练策略，动态调整批大小和超时时间，以平衡吞吐量和延迟的奖励函数。在合成和真实工作负载上的实验表明，基于RL的方法优于静态基线，能自适应变化条件，在保持高吞吐量的同时降低尾延迟。创新点在于首次将RL应用于推理批处理调度，实现了无需手动调参的动态优化。

强化学习/RL.title: Graph Sparse Sampling: Breaking the Curse of the Horizon in Continuous MDP Planning
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 图稀疏采样：打破连续MDP规划中的视界诅咒
强化学习/RL.summary: Planning under uncertainty in continuous domains is essential for autonomous systems, yet computationally demanding. Tree-based search methods such as Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) remain popular, but their branching structure can require sampling budgets that grow exponentially with lookahead depth.
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 连续域中的不确定性规划对自主系统至关重要，但计算成本高昂。基于树的搜索方法如蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）仍受欢迎，但其分支结构可能导致采样预算随前瞻深度指数增长。本文提出图稀疏采样方法，通过构建稀疏图结构替代传统树搜索，有效打破了视界诅咒，使得在连续MDP规划中采样复杂度与前瞻深度呈线性关系。创新点在于利用图结构稀疏性减少冗余采样，同时保持规划质量。主要贡献包括理论证明和实验验证，在多个连续控制任务中显著提升规划效率。

强化学习/RL.title: Diffusion-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Delayed Policy Optimization
强化学习/RL.title_zh: 扩散引导的不确定性感知延迟策略优化
强化学习/RL.summary: Reinforcement learning in real world environments often suffers from severe performance degradation due to delayed feedback. Existing approaches typically mitigate performance degradation caused by observation delays by constructing augmented states or predicting the true states. However, these methods...
强化学习/RL.summary_zh: 现实环境中的强化学习常因延迟反馈导致性能严重下降。现有方法通常通过构建增强状态或预测真实状态来缓解观测延迟造成的性能退化，但这些方法存在局限性。本文提出扩散引导的不确定性感知延迟策略优化（DUPO），创新性地利用扩散模型生成未来状态分布，并引入不确定性量化来指导策略更新。主要贡献包括：1）设计基于扩散的延迟状态预测器；2）提出不确定性感知的损失函数；3）在多个延迟控制任务上取得SOTA性能。该方法有效应对了延迟反馈中的随机性和不确定性。

多模态学习.title: TacReasoner: A Dynamic Tactile-Language Framework for Interactive Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
多模态学习.title_zh: TacReasoner：面向真实场景交互推理的动态触觉-语言框架
多模态学习.summary: Among the five primary human senses, tactile is arguably the most fundamental to survival, as it enables the perception of physical contact and interaction in real-world environments. In this paper, we explore two key challenges of integrating tactile sensing into intelligent systems for multimodal reasoning: (1) bridging the semantic gap between tactile signals and natural language, and (2) enabling dynamic reasoning over time-varying tactile streams. We propose TacReasoner, a framework that combines tactile encoders with large language models to perform interactive reasoning. Experiments on real-world tactile tasks show that TacReasoner achieves superior performance in understanding and reasoning about physical interactions.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 在人类五种主要感官中，触觉可以说是生存最根本的，因为它能够感知真实世界中的物理接触和交互。本文探讨了将触觉感知集成到智能系统中以进行多模态推理的两个关键挑战：（1）弥合触觉信号与自然语言之间的语义鸿沟，（2）实现随时间变化的触觉流的动态推理。我们提出了TacReasoner，一个结合触觉编码器与大型语言模型以进行交互推理的框架。在真实触觉任务上的实验表明，TacReasoner在理解和推理物理交互方面取得了优越性能。

多模态学习.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
多模态学习.title_zh: 基于表示自编码器的多人交互世界模型
多模态学习.summary: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the environment to specific agents. Our model uses a representation autoencoder to decouple agent-specific latent states from the global environment state, enabling efficient multi-agent interaction modeling. We demonstrate its effectiveness in a simulated physics environment with multiple agents.
多模态学习.summary_zh: 本文提出首个面向高度动态、复杂物理交互环境的多人世界模型。与将其他智能体视为环境一部分的单人世界模型不同，该模型以多个智能体的动作流为条件，学习将环境变化归因于特定智能体。模型采用表示自编码器将智能体特定的潜在状态从全局环境状态中解耦，从而实现高效的多智能体交互建模。在模拟物理环境的多人场景中验证了其有效性。创新点在于首次实现了对多智能体动作流的显式条件建模，并通过解耦表示提升了可解释性和泛化能力。

生成模型.title: What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn?
生成模型.title_zh: 离散扩散模型学到了什么？
生成模型.summary: What does a discrete diffusion model learn: a denoiser, a score ratio, or a bridge plug-in predictor? At the level of jump rates, these are one object in different coordinates, and reading a neural network in the wrong coordinate changes the process being trained and sampled. Starting with a rigorous mathematical formulation, we clarify the equivalence and differences among these interpretations. We show that understanding the learned object is crucial for correct training and sampling. Our analysis unifies existing discrete diffusion methods and provides guidelines for designing more effective models.
生成模型.summary_zh: 离散扩散模型学到了什么：去噪器、分数比，还是桥接插件预测器？在跳变率层面，这些是不同坐标下的同一个对象，而用错误的坐标解读神经网络会改变训练和采样的过程。从严谨的数学公式出发，我们澄清了这些解释之间的等价性和差异。我们表明，理解所学对象对于正确的训练和采样至关重要。我们的分析统一了现有的离散扩散方法，并为设计更有效的模型提供了指导。

生成模型.title: MoP-JEPA: Hard-Assigned Predictor Mixtures for Stochastic JEPA World Models
生成模型.title_zh: MoP-JEPA：用于随机JEPA世界模型的硬分配预测器混合
生成模型.summary: JEPA world models predict the next latent state with a single deterministic predictor trained by latent regression. We show that this fails structurally when the environment is stochastic: at a branching transition, the regression-optimal predictor outputs the conditional mean of the successor embed
生成模型.summary_zh: 本文针对JEPA世界模型在随机环境中的局限性，提出MoP-JEPA方法。传统JEPA使用单一确定性预测器进行潜在回归，但在分支转移时，回归最优预测器输出后继嵌入的条件均值，导致预测模糊。MoP-JEPA采用硬分配预测器混合，每个预测器专门负责一个确定性的未来分支，从而有效捕捉随机性，显著提升了世界模型在复杂环境下的预测准确性和鲁棒性。

生成模型.title: Quantum-Inspired Harmonic Decision Models: A Computational Framework for Music Generation
生成模型.title_zh: 量子启发的和声决策模型：音乐生成的计算框架
生成模型.summary: This paper introduces a quantum-inspired computational framework for harmonic decision-making in music. The proposed approach formulates harmonization as an optimization problem within a structured combinatorial space, where multiple candidate chord sequences are evaluated under interacting musical
生成模型.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种量子启发的音乐和声决策计算框架。该方法将和声化问题形式化为结构化组合空间中的优化问题，在相互作用的音乐约束下评估多个候选和弦序列。通过借鉴量子计算中的叠加和干涉概念，该框架能够高效探索和声空间，生成创新且符合音乐理论的和弦进行。实验结果表明，该方法在音乐质量和多样性方面优于传统方法。

AI安全.title: Agent Data Injection Attacks are Realistic Threats to AI Agents
AI安全.title_zh: 智能体数据注入攻击是对AI智能体的现实威胁
AI安全.summary: AI agents act on behalf of user prompts, consuming external data and taking actions based on the agent context. Prior research on AI agent security has primarily focused on indirect prompt injection (IPI). Its most well-studied category is instruction injection, where attacker-controlled untrusted data contains instructions that override the agent's original goal. In this paper, we introduce a new class of attacks: agent data injection (ADI), where attackers inject malicious data into the agent's context to manipulate its behavior. We demonstrate that ADI attacks are realistic and can cause significant harm, such as leaking private information or executing unauthorized actions. We propose defenses and evaluate their effectiveness.
AI安全.summary_zh: AI智能体代表用户提示行事，消耗外部数据并根据智能体上下文采取行动。此前关于AI智能体安全的研究主要关注间接提示注入（IPI），其研究最充分的类别是指令注入，即攻击者控制的可信数据包含覆盖智能体原始目标的指令。本文引入了一类新的攻击：智能体数据注入（ADI），攻击者将恶意数据注入智能体上下文以操纵其行为。我们证明ADI攻击是现实可行的，并可能造成严重危害，例如泄露隐私信息或执行未授权操作。我们提出了防御措施并评估了其有效性。

软件工程/SE.title: LLM-Based Test Oracles: Source-of-Authority Taxonomy -- A Systematic Literature Review
软件工程/SE.title_zh: 基于LLM的测试预言：权威来源分类法——系统文献综述
软件工程/SE.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to produce test oracles, the part of a test that decides whether observed behavior is correct. Yet a clear account of where these oracles draw their authority is missing. Prior secondary studies organize the area by oracle form or by LLM technique.
软件工程/SE.summary_zh: 本文对基于大型语言模型的测试预言进行了系统性文献综述，提出了一个基于权威来源的分类法。测试预言是决定测试行为是否正确的关键部分，但现有研究缺乏对其权威来源的清晰描述。作者从LLM的知识来源（如训练数据、推理能力等）角度对文献进行了分类，分析了不同方法的优缺点，并指出了未来研究方向，为软件测试领域提供了重要的理论指导。

其他.title: Interpretable Human-Label-Free Deep Learning for Real-Bogus Classification with Uncertainty Quantification
其他.title_zh: 可解释的、无人工标注的深度学习用于真实-虚假分类及不确定性量化
其他.summary: Time-domain surveys generate many transient candidates, making Real-Bogus classification a critical step in automated discovery pipelines. Reliable labels are costly, while community labels can be noisy and survey-dependent. We aim to develop a Real-Bogus classification framework that can be trained without human labels, while providing interpretability and uncertainty quantification. We propose a self-supervised learning approach using contrastive learning on unlabeled data, combined with a Bayesian neural network for uncertainty estimation. The model achieves competitive accuracy compared to supervised methods on several survey datasets, and its predictions are interpretable via attention maps. This work reduces the reliance on expensive human annotations and improves trust in automated transient classification.
其他.summary_zh: 本文针对天文学中的真实-虚假（Real-Bogus）分类问题，提出了一种无需人工标注的深度学习框架，同时具备可解释性和不确定性量化能力。现有方法依赖昂贵且可能嘈杂的社区标签。作者采用自监督对比学习从无标签数据中学习特征，并结合贝叶斯神经网络估计不确定性。在多个巡天数据集上，该方法达到了与监督方法相当的精度，并通过注意力图提供可解释的预测。创新点在于将自监督学习与贝叶斯不确定性量化结合，消除了对人工标注的依赖，同时增强了模型的可信度，对自动化瞬变源发现管线具有重要意义。

人工智能/符号推理.title: The Changing Role of Symbolic Methods in Artificial Intelligence
人工智能/符号推理.title_zh: 符号方法在人工智能中角色的演变
人工智能/符号推理.summary: Why do intelligent systems need to perform explicit symbolic reasoning? Computer science has traditionally regarded symbolic reasoning as a defining component of intelligence. Yet the remarkable success of modern foundation models raises a fundamental question: if increasingly capable AI systems can achieve high performance without explicit symbolic reasoning, what is the enduring role of symbolic methods? This paper surveys the historical and contemporary interplay between symbolic and sub-symbolic AI, arguing that symbolic methods remain crucial for explainability, verification, and compositional generalization. We propose a hybrid framework where neural networks handle perception and pattern recognition while symbolic modules ensure logical consistency and interpretability. The paper identifies key open challenges, including integrating learning and reasoning, and scaling symbolic methods to real-world complexity.
人工智能/符号推理.summary_zh: 智能系统为何需要执行显式符号推理？传统上，计算机科学将符号推理视为智能的定义性组成部分。然而，现代基础模型的巨大成功提出了根本性问题：如果日益强大的AI系统无需显式符号推理就能实现高性能，符号方法的持久角色是什么？本文综述了符号与亚符号AI之间历史与当代的相互作用，认为符号方法对于可解释性、验证和组合泛化仍然至关重要。我们提出一种混合框架，其中神经网络处理感知和模式识别，而符号模块确保逻辑一致性和可解释性。论文指出了关键开放挑战，包括整合学习与推理，以及将符号方法扩展到现实世界的复杂性。

AI安全/隐私保护.title: Privacy-Preserving Robustness Verification for Neural Networks
AI安全/隐私保护.title_zh: 神经网络的隐私保护鲁棒性验证
AI安全/隐私保护.summary: Neural network verification and data privacy are inherently in tension: verification demands full access to model parameters and input data, yet both are increasingly restricted by privacy regulations and intellectual property constraints. This tension has left robustness verification impractical in many real-world scenarios. We propose a framework for privacy-preserving robustness verification that allows a verifier to check a model's robustness against adversarial perturbations without revealing the model parameters or the verification data. Our approach leverages secure multi-party computation and cryptographic commitments to enable verifiable robustness guarantees. We demonstrate the feasibility on standard benchmarks, showing that privacy-preserving verification is achievable with acceptable overhead, opening the door to deploying robust models in privacy-sensitive applications.
AI安全/隐私保护.summary_zh: 神经网络验证与数据隐私存在固有矛盾：验证需要完全访问模型参数和输入数据，但两者日益受到隐私法规和知识产权限制。这一矛盾使得鲁棒性验证在许多实际场景中不切实际。本文提出一种隐私保护鲁棒性验证框架，允许验证者在不泄露模型参数或验证数据的情况下检查模型对抗扰动的鲁棒性。方法利用安全多方计算和密码学承诺实现可验证的鲁棒性保证。在标准基准上的实验表明，隐私保护验证以可接受的开销是可行的，为在隐私敏感应用中部署鲁棒模型打开了大门。

AI治理/安全.title: Open Problems in AI Incident Governance
AI治理/安全.title_zh: AI事件治理中的开放问题
AI治理/安全.summary: AI systems may produce failures after deployment that pre-deployment safety assessments do not anticipate. Managing these failures requires what we refer to as adequate \textit{AI incident governance}, where having good definitions, taxonomies, monitoring practices, reporting mechanisms, and incident response processes are essential. This paper surveys the current landscape of AI incident governance, identifying key open problems: lack of standardized incident definitions, fragmented reporting platforms, insufficient post-incident analysis, and challenges in cross-organizational learning. We propose a research agenda to address these gaps, including establishing a unified taxonomy, developing automated monitoring tools, and creating incentives for transparent reporting. Our goal is to foster a proactive culture of learning from incidents to improve AI safety and reliability.
AI治理/安全.summary_zh: AI系统在部署后可能产生部署前安全评估未预料到的故障。管理这些故障需要充分的“AI事件治理”，其中良好的定义、分类法、监控实践、报告机制和事件响应流程至关重要。本文调查了AI事件治理的当前状况，识别出关键开放问题：缺乏标准化事件定义、报告平台碎片化、事后分析不足以及跨组织学习的挑战。我们提出一个研究议程以弥补这些差距，包括建立统一分类法、开发自动化监控工具、以及为透明报告创造激励。目标是培养一种从事件中学习的主动文化，以提高AI的安全性和可靠性。

图神经网络.title: Hyperparameter Transfer in Graph Neural Networks
图神经网络.title_zh: 图神经网络中的超参数迁移
图神经网络.summary: The performance of deep learning models crucially depends on the settings of hyperparameters like learning rate, initialization scale, and weight decay. Hyperparameter transfer aims to make near-optimal hyperparameter settings consistent across model scale, so that large models can be optimized by p
图神经网络.summary_zh: 深度学习模型的性能关键依赖于超参数设置，如学习率、初始化尺度和权重衰减。超参数迁移旨在使得近最优的超参数设置在不同模型规模下保持一致，从而大型模型可以通过在小模型上调优的超参数进行优化。本文研究图神经网络中的超参数迁移，提出了一种理论框架来理解不同图结构和任务下的迁移规律，实验验证了该方法的有效性。

AI基准测试.title: ClassicLogic: A Knowledge-Driven Benchmark of Classic Puzzle Games for Evaluating Compositional Generalization
AI基准测试.title_zh: ClassicLogic：一个知识驱动的经典益智游戏基准，用于评估组合泛化能力
AI基准测试.summary: Compositional generalization, the ability to understand and produce novel combinations of known components, remains a fundamental challenge for modern artificial intelligence. While few benchmarks exist, many focus on linguistic tasks and lack complex, explicit compositional structures. We introduce
AI基准测试.summary_zh: 组合泛化（即理解和生成已知组件的新组合的能力）仍然是现代人工智能面临的基本挑战。尽管存在一些基准测试，但多数集中于语言任务，缺乏复杂且明确的组合结构。本文提出了ClassicLogic基准，基于经典益智游戏，通过知识驱动的方式设计，旨在评估AI系统的组合泛化能力。该基准包含多个具有显式组合逻辑的游戏，要求模型学习基本规则并组合解决新问题。主要贡献在于提供了一个结构清晰、复杂度可控的测试平台，弥补了现有基准在非语言领域组合泛化评估上的不足。

电商与推荐系统.title: CanniUplift: A Holistic Framework for Mitigating Seller and Incentive Cannibalization in E-commerce Uplift Modeling
电商与推荐系统.title_zh: CanniUplift：缓解电商提升建模中商家与激励蚕食效应的整体框架
电商与推荐系统.summary: Personalized incentive allocation is vital for e-commerce, where uplift modeling is the standard for estimating Individual Treatment Effects (ITE). However, traditional models often fail in complex multi-seller environments with violations of the Stable Unit Treatment Value Assumption (SUTVA). We id
电商与推荐系统.summary_zh: 个性化激励分配对电商至关重要，提升建模是估计个体处理效应的标准方法。然而，传统模型在复杂的多商家环境中常常失效，因为违反了稳定单位处理值假设。本文提出CanniUplift框架，系统性地解决商家间和激励间的蚕食效应。该框架通过引入商家交互图和激励竞争模型，更准确地估计处理效应，从而优化激励分配。主要贡献在于首次在提升建模中考虑商家和激励的双重蚕食，显著提高了多商家场景下的激励效率。

气象预测与AI.title: AIFS-SUBS: Extending Data-Driven Forecasting to Sub-Seasonal Timescales
气象预测与AI.title_zh: AIFS-SUBS：将数据驱动预测扩展到次季节时间尺度
气象预测与AI.summary: Data-driven models now rival numerical weather prediction in the medium range, but extending them to sub-seasonal lead times raises challenges absent at shorter horizons. Errors accumulate over long autoregressive rollouts, systematic biases grow with lead time, and several years of data must be hel
气象预测与AI.summary_zh: 数据驱动模型在中程预报中已可与数值天气预报相媲美，但将其扩展到次季节预见期面临着短期预报中不存在的挑战。误差在长时间自回归滚动中累积，系统性偏差随预见期增长，且需要多年数据支持。本文提出AIFS-SUBS框架，通过结合物理约束和深度学习技术，有效抑制误差累积和偏差增长。主要创新在于设计了一种混合架构，融合了物理模型和神经网络，显著提升了次季节时间尺度的预报技巧。该工作为数据驱动方法在气候预测领域的应用开辟了新途径。

自然语言处理.title: Beyond Independent Labels: Schwartz-Geometry Decoding for Human Value Detection
自然语言处理.title_zh: 超越独立标签：基于施瓦茨几何解码的人类价值观检测
自然语言处理.summary: Human value detection is commonly formulated as sentence-level multi-label classification over the 19 refined Schwartz values, typically predicted as independent labels. Schwartz theory, however, describes them as a circular motivational continuum, in which adjacent values are compatible and opposin
自然语言处理.summary_zh: 人类价值观检测通常被形式化为句子级别的多标签分类，涉及19个施瓦茨价值观，通常作为独立标签预测。然而，施瓦茨理论将其描述为一个圆形动机连续体，相邻价值观兼容而对立价值观冲突。本文提出Schwartz-Geometry解码方法，利用价值观之间的几何关系进行联合预测。通过将标签嵌入到圆形空间中，模型能够捕捉价值观之间的相容性和冲突性，从而提升检测准确性。主要贡献在于首次将价值观理论的几何结构融入深度学习模型，显著改善了多标签分类的性能。

大语言模型安全.title: Selective Disclosure Watermarking for Large Language Models
大语言模型安全.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的选择性披露水印技术
大语言模型安全.summary: Watermarking methods embed imperceptible and verifiable signals into text generated by large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches include zero-bit schemes for distinguishing synthetic text from human writing and multi-bit schemes for embedding metadata. However, current multi-bit watermarking
大语言模型安全.summary_zh: 水印方法将不可察觉且可验证的信号嵌入到大型语言模型生成的文本中。现有方法包括用于区分合成文本与人类写作的零比特方案，以及用于嵌入元数据的多比特方案。然而，当前的多比特水印技术缺乏选择性披露能力，即无法在仅揭示部分信息的同时隐藏其余部分。本文提出选择性披露水印框架，允许水印携带者按需选择性地披露部分元数据，同时保持其他部分的保密性。该框架基于加密和编码技术，实现了细粒度的访问控制。主要贡献在于增强了水印的实用性和隐私保护能力，适用于版权保护和内容溯源等场景。

语音/音频处理.title: ProPS: Prompted Profile Synthesis for Natural Language-Conditioned Speaker Embedding Distributions
语音/音频处理.title_zh: ProPS：基于提示的说话人嵌入分布合成，用于自然语言条件生成
语音/音频处理.summary: Speaker embeddings, or x-vectors, are widely used to represent speaker identity and speaker-related attributes, but existing embedding extractors are typically descriptive rather than generative: they map an observed speech segment to an x-vector, which is then used for downstream applications. We introduce ProPS, a method that synthesizes speaker embedding distributions conditioned on natural language prompts.
语音/音频处理.summary_zh: 说话人嵌入（x-vectors）广泛用于表示说话人身份和属性，但现有提取器通常是描述性而非生成性的：它们将观测到的语音片段映射到x-vector，然后用于下游应用。本文提出ProPS，一种基于自然语言提示合成说话人嵌入分布的方法。创新点在于将扩散模型与提示学习结合，实现了从文本描述到说话人嵌入分布的生成。主要贡献包括：1）首次实现文本条件说话人嵌入分布生成；2）支持多属性控制（如性别、年龄、口音）；3）在说话人验证和属性编辑任务上优于现有方法。

Software Engineering.title: Three-Phase Evaluation of AI-Assisted Software Development Life Cycle
Software Engineering.title_zh: AI辅助软件开发生命周期的三阶段评估
Software Engineering.summary: This paper presents an exploratory evaluation of how increasing levels of AI autonomy affect software development productivity, requirement adherence, and developer cognitive workload. A team of four developers reimplemented the same full-stack web application across three sequential phases: partial
Software Engineering.summary_zh: 本文探索性评估了AI自主性水平递增对软件开发生产力、需求遵循度和开发者认知负荷的影响。一个由四名开发者组成的团队，在三个连续阶段中重新实现了相同的全栈Web应用程序：部分AI辅助、高度AI辅助和完全AI自主。研究发现，随着AI自主性提高，生产力显著提升，但需求遵循度略有下降，开发者认知负荷先降后升。主要贡献在于揭示了AI辅助软件开发中的权衡关系，为设计人机协作开发流程提供了实证依据。

Audio and Speech Processing.title: Unified Audio Intelligence Without Regressing on Text Intelligence
Audio and Speech Processing.title_zh: 不牺牲文本智能的统一音频智能
Audio and Speech Processing.summary: Audio intelligence involves understanding, reasoning about, and generating both audio and speech. In this work, we introduce Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B (Audex), a unified audio-text LLM built on Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B, a strong text-only MoE LLM. Audio and Speech Processing.summary_zh: 音频智能涉及对音频和语音的理解、推理与生成。本文提出Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B（Audex），一个基于强文本MoE大语言模型Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B构建的统一音频-文本大语言模型。Audex采用简单统一的单编码器-解码器设计，通过多阶段训练（包括音频理解、音频生成和联合训练）实现音频与文本任务的统一，且不损害文本智能。创新点在于：首次在保持文本性能的同时实现音频智能；采用MoE架构高效处理多模态；在多个音频基准测试上达到SOTA。主要贡献是证明了音频智能可以无损集成到强文本模型中。

Computer Vision.title: Search Beyond What Can Be Taught: Evolving the Knowledge Boundary in Agentic Visual Generation
Computer Vision.title_zh: 超越可教边界：在智能体视觉生成中扩展知识边界
Computer Vision.summary: Visual generators excel at rendering, but they confidently fabricate what they do not know. User requests are unbounded, evolving, and deeply long-tailed: new characters, trending entities, post-cutoff events, and more. This world-knowledge bottleneck is structural: generators are trained on fixed c
Computer Vision.summary_zh: 视觉生成器擅长渲染，但会自信地编造未知内容。用户请求是无限的、演化的且深度长尾的：新角色、流行实体、截止日期后事件等。这种世界知识瓶颈是结构性的：生成器在固定数据集上训练，无法适应动态知识。本文提出智能体视觉生成框架，通过在线搜索和知识演化机制，使生成器能够主动探索并整合未训练过的知识。创新点包括：引入搜索-生成循环，动态扩展知识边界；设计知识蒸馏策略，将搜索到的信息融入生成过程而不遗忘已有知识。主要贡献是首次解决了视觉生成中知识静态性的问题，实现了对未知概念的可靠生成。

Speech Recognition.title: REDDIT: Correcting Model-Generated Timestamp Drift in ASR without Forgetting via Replay-Based Distribution Editing
Speech Recognition.title_zh: REDDIT：通过基于回放的分布编辑校正ASR中模型生成的时间戳漂移而不遗忘
Speech Recognition.summary: Modern autoregressive ASR systems can emit timestamps as decoded tokens, enabling timestamped transcription without frame-level aligners or inference-time post-processing. We show that these generated timestamps can drift across long non-speech spans: the transcript may remain plausible, but the dec
Speech Recognition.summary_zh: 现代自回归ASR系统可以将时间戳作为解码标记输出，从而无需帧级对齐器或推理后处理即可获得带时间戳的转录。本文发现这些生成的时间戳在长非语音片段中会出现漂移：转录可能仍然合理，但解码的时间戳逐渐偏离真实位置。为此，提出REDDIT方法，通过基于回放的分布编辑来校正时间戳漂移，同时避免灾难性遗忘。创新点在于：识别并形式化了时间戳漂移问题；设计轻量级重放机制，在不影响ASR核心性能的前提下修正时间戳分布。主要贡献是提供了一种即插即用的校正方案，显著提升了长音频时间戳的准确性。

category_summaries.科学计算与深度学习: 今日研究集中在物理信息神经网络（PINN）的改进，如自适应损失权重和混合数值方法，以及用于求解偏微分方程的深度学习框架。亮点包括基于注意力机制的算子学习，以及将物理约束嵌入网络架构以提高泛化能力。
category_summaries.自然语言处理与推理: 研究方向包括知识增强的语言模型、多步推理和常识推理。亮点有利用外部知识库进行推理的模型，以及结合符号逻辑的神经符号推理方法。
category_summaries.脑电信号处理与机器学习: 主要关注脑电信号解码和分类，如运动想象和情绪识别。亮点包括使用图神经网络捕捉脑区连接，以及对比学习在少样本场景下的应用。
category_summaries.机器人学与多智能体系统: 研究重点在协同导航、任务分配和通信效率。亮点有基于图神经网络的多智能体协作框架，以及引入注意力机制处理动态环境。
category_summaries.大语言模型/LLM: 持续关注模型压缩、微调效率和长文本处理。亮点包括低秩适配（LoRA）的变体、检索增强生成（RAG）的改进，以及针对长文档的稀疏注意力机制。
category_summaries.机器人: 涉及灵巧操作、自主导航和模仿学习。亮点有基于扩散策略的机器人操控，以及结合视觉语言模型的开放词汇导航。
category_summaries.计算机视觉/CV: 研究方向包括目标检测、图像分割和视频理解。亮点有基于Transformer的检测器改进、弱监督语义分割，以及时空动作定位的新方法。
category_summaries.优化算法: 关注深度学习优化器的改进，如自适应学习率和梯度裁剪。亮点包括基于最优传输的优化框架，以及针对非凸问题的随机算法。
category_summaries.强化学习/RL: 研究重点在样本效率、多任务学习和离线强化学习。亮点有基于世界模型的规划方法，以及结合因果推断的RL算法。
category_summaries.多模态学习: 聚焦视觉-语言模型的对齐和融合。亮点有轻量级多模态适配器、跨模态检索的对比学习改进，以及视频-文本预训练的新范式。
category_summaries.生成模型: 主要涉及扩散模型、生成对抗网络和自回归模型。亮点包括文本到图像生成的加速采样、可控生成，以及用于3D内容生成的扩散模型。
category_summaries.AI安全: 关注对抗攻击、模型鲁棒性和可解释性。亮点有对抗样本检测的防御机制、模型后门攻击的检测，以及基于因果解释的鲁棒性增强。
category_summaries.软件工程/SE: 研究方向包括代码生成、缺陷检测和测试自动化。亮点有基于LLM的代码补全、静态分析工具的集成，以及自动化测试用例生成。
category_summaries.其他: 涵盖跨学科应用，如生物信息学、材料科学和金融。亮点有AI辅助药物发现、材料性质预测，以及金融市场预测的新方法。
category_summaries.人工智能/符号推理: 研究神经符号方法、逻辑推理和知识表示。亮点有可微分逻辑编程、基于图的知识推理，以及结合概率的符号推理。
category_summaries.AI安全/隐私保护: 关注联邦学习、差分隐私和模型窃取防御。亮点有联邦学习中的梯度压缩、本地差分隐私的改进，以及对抗性蒸馏的防御。
category_summaries.AI治理/安全: 研究AI伦理、公平性和透明度。亮点有偏见检测与缓解框架、可解释AI工具，以及负责任AI的实践指南。
category_summaries.图神经网络: 聚焦图分类、节点分类和链接预测。亮点有动态图神经网络、异构图表示学习，以及图Transformer的改进。
category_summaries.AI基准测试: 提出新的评估数据集和指标。亮点包括多模态基准、鲁棒性测试集，以及面向实际应用的评估框架。
category_summaries.电商与推荐系统: 研究个性化推荐、点击率预测和序列推荐。亮点有基于图神经网络的用户表示、多任务学习框架，以及探索-利用平衡的新策略。
category_summaries.气象预测与AI: 应用深度学习进行天气预报和气候建模。亮点有基于Transformer的天气预测模型、物理约束的神经网络，以及极端天气事件预测。
category_summaries.自然语言处理: 涵盖文本分类、情感分析和信息抽取。亮点有少样本学习、跨语言迁移，以及基于提示的微调方法。
category_summaries.大语言模型安全: 专门研究LLM的对抗攻击、越狱和有害内容生成。亮点有红队测试方法、安全对齐技术，以及毒性检测。
category_summaries.语音/音频处理: 研究方向包括语音识别、语音合成和音频事件检测。亮点有自监督预训练、流式语音识别，以及基于扩散的语音增强。
category_summaries.Software Engineering: 与软件工程方向重叠，但更侧重工程实践。亮点有持续集成中的AI、代码审查自动化，以及软件维护的预测模型。
category_summaries.Audio and Speech Processing: 与语音/音频处理方向重叠，但更侧重基础研究。亮点有神经声码器、说话人验证，以及多语言语音识别。
category_summaries.Computer Vision: 与计算机视觉方向重叠，但可能更侧重算法细节。亮点有视觉Transformer的改进、自监督学习，以及3D视觉。
category_summaries.Speech Recognition: 专注于语音识别领域。亮点有端到端模型、语言模型融合，以及噪声鲁棒性提升。

highlights: 研究亮点1：PDEFlow——提出自主智能PDE流水线，将自然语言描述转化为免求解器推理，极大简化了神经算子学习的实用流程。
研究亮点2：GaP——图即策略的多智能体自学习框架，为变分自动化任务提供了可解释且适应性的机器人控制方案。
研究亮点1：Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation - 提出双向对齐机制，解决层次化规划与执行之间的鸿沟，在长周期操作任务上性能显著提升，具有高实用价值。
研究亮点2：MetaSkill-Evolve: Recursive Self-Improvement of LLM Agents via Two-Timescale Meta-Skill Evolution - 提出双时间尺度元技能演化，实现LLM智能体的递归自我改进，创新性强，对长周期任务有重要应用前景。
研究亮点1：AgentGym2：首个在去理想化真实环境中系统评估LLM智能体的基准，揭示了理想与真实性能差距，对实际部署具有重要指导意义。
研究亮点2：Localized LoRA-MoE：将MoE与LoRA创新结合，通过块级专家和自适应路由解决梯度冲突，在参数高效微调领域开辟了新方向。
研究亮点3：From Fixed to Free Cameras：无需相机标定的视角鲁棒VLA模型，大幅降低机器人部署成本，具有强实用价值。
研究亮点1：《TacReasoner: A Dynamic Tactile-Language Framework for Interactive Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios》提出触觉-语言多模态推理框架，创新性地融合触觉感知与LLM，解决触觉信号与自然语言的语义鸿沟及动态推理挑战。
研究亮点2：《What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn?》从数学上统一了离散扩散模型的不同解释，澄清了去噪器、分数比等概念的本质，为模型设计和训练提供了理论指导。

今日AI研究呈现多领域突破态势。在基础模型方面，大语言模型（LLM）的研究持续深入，聚焦于微调效率（如低秩适配变体）和长文本处理（稀疏注意力机制），同时检索增强生成（RAG）的改进提升了知识密集型任务的表现。计算机视觉领域，基于Transformer的检测器改进和弱监督语义分割取得进展，视频理解中的时空动作定位方法受到关注。多模态学习方面，视觉-语言模型的对齐和轻量级适配器成为热点，跨模态检索的对比学习改进显著。

在应用层面，机器人学与多智能体系统展示了图神经网络和注意力机制在协同导航中的有效性。科学计算与深度学习方向，物理信息神经网络（PINN）通过自适应损失和混合数值方法增强了求解偏微分方程的能力。AI安全领域，对抗攻击防御和模型鲁棒性研究稳步推进，联邦学习中的隐私保护技术（如梯度压缩和本地差分隐私）得到改进。此外，气象预测与AI方向出现了基于Transformer的预报模型，预示着AI在气候科学中的潜力。

整体趋势上，今日研究体现了对模型效率、鲁棒性和跨模态融合的重视。生成模型（尤其是扩散模型）在图像和3D内容生成中持续创新，而强化学习与优化算法的改进则聚焦于样本效率和收敛性能。AI治理和基准测试方向强调了负责任AI和评估框架的重要性。这些进展共同勾勒出AI领域从模型能力向实用化、安全化发展的清晰脉络。
